Name: Applied Storage
Author: moyueranshang
Description:
[b]Applied Storage[/b]
A better storage mod — with built-in automation, unlimited storage, vanilla chest management, and multiplayer support.
Everything you put in becomes part of one shared pool that follows you across the whole save, so you never have to remember which chest holds your coal. The terminal is a search box first and everything else second: type a name (pinyin works too) and take what you need.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlimited shared storage pool. Stackable goods merge into a single number; items that carry state (preserves with their ingredient, dyed items, items with mod data) are stored as complete instances and come back exactly as they were.[/*]
[*]Storage Controller. Place it anywhere; it anchors your network. Right-click to open the terminal.[/*]
[*]Terminal. Search by name or ID (pinyin supported for Chinese), eight category tabs (All / Ore / Metal Bars / Materials / Edible / Decor / Seeds / Other), colour picker for the interface.[/*]
[*]Craft from storage. The vanilla crafting menu pulls missing ingredients straight from the pool, so you can craft without digging through chests.[/*]
[*]Storage Interface. Place it beside machines and it feeds them from the pool and collects their output. Works with vanilla machines and most modded ones. Connection range of 1, 3 or 5 tiles (3/5 bridges the gaps between trees).[/*]
[*]Crystalarium re-tooling. If a copy machine is duplicating something that is not in the interface's sample list, it is switched to one that is (can be turned off).[/*]
[*]Wireless Access Terminal. A portable key: J opens the terminal, U opens crafting, L stores everything from your inventory — anywhere.[/*]
[*]Manage vanilla chests. Hold the wireless terminal and right-click a chest to add it to the network; its contents show up in the terminal alongside the pool.[/*]
[*]Shipping. Alt+click a sample to ship the whole stack from storage, and a shipping bin button opens the vanilla bin so you can take things back before the night sale.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer. Host-authoritative by design: the pool lives in the host's save, clients share the same network, and only one player can operate the interface at a time. No item duplication.[/*]
[*]Fully configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu (optional). Item descriptions double as tutorials — hover to learn what a block does.[/*]
[*]9 languages: English, Simplified Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean.[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer (for Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*]Unzip
[code]AppliedStorage 0.2.2.zip[/code]into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Start the game and load a save. A welcome letter with the Storage Controller will be in your mailbox; craft more from the crafting menu.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+ (the mod runs on the host; clients only need SMAPI)[/*]
[/list][b]How it stays simple[/b]
Nothing is forced on you: no menus open by themselves, no blocks are placed for you, and every automation switch can be turned off. If you just want a bigger chest, use the terminal. If you want a factory, add interfaces.
[b]Questions and feedback[/b]
Found a bug, or want a language polished by a native speaker? Comments are very welcome. Community translations for German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese and Korean are included as drafts — corrections are appreciated and credited.

[b]应用存储 / Applied Storage[/b]
一个更好的存储模组：自带自动化、无限存储、原版箱子管理，支持多人模式。
放进去的东西会汇成一份全局存储池，跟着你的存档走 —— 再也不用记煤放在哪个箱子里。终端先是一块搜索框，其次才是别的：输入名字（支持拼音）就能取出你要的东西。
[b]功能[/b]
[list]
[*]无限共享存储池。能堆叠的材料按数字合并；带状态的东西（果酱与它的原料、染色物品、带 modData 的实例）整份保存，取出来和存进去时一模一样。[/*]
[*]存储控制器。放在任何地方，它是整个网络的锚点；右键开终端。[/*]
[*]终端。按名字或 ID 搜索（中文支持拼音），八个分类标签（全部 / 矿石 / 金属锭 / 材料 / 可食用 / 装饰 / 种子 / 其他），另有取色器。[/*]
[*]从存储池合成。原版制作页缺料时直接从池里补，不必翻箱子凑材料。[/*]
[*]存储接口。贴着机器放，自动从池里投料、回收产物；原版机器与多数模组机器都能用。连通范围 1 / 3 / 5 格（3 和 5 能跨过树与树之间的空隙）。[/*]
[*]宝石复制机换品种。复制机正在复制的东西不在样本白名单里时，自动换成名单里的品种（可关闭）。[/*]
[*]无线访问终端。一把随身钥匙：J 开终端、U 开合成、L 一键存背包 —— 在任何地方。[/*]
[*]管理原版箱子。手持无线终端右键箱子即可纳入网络，箱内物品会和存储池一起显示在终端里。[/*]
[*]出货。Alt+点击样本格，把池里该物品整份送进出货箱；出货箱按钮打开原版出货箱，当晚结算前还能取回来。[/*]
[*]多人。以房主为权威：存储池存在房主存档里，客机共享同一个网络，同一时间只允许一个人操作界面，不会出现物品复制。[/*]
[*]可在 GMCM 里完整配置（可选）。物品说明本身就是教程，悬停即可读懂。[/*]
[*]9 种语言：英文、简体中文、德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、俄语、日语、韩语。[/*]
[/list][b]安装[/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 4.0.0 或更新版本（对应星露谷物语 1.6+）。[/*]
[*]把
[code]AppliedStorage 0.2.2.zip[/code]解压到
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹。[/*]
[*]可选但推荐：安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，以便在游戏内调整设置。[/*]
[*]启动游戏并读取存档。信箱里会有一封带「应用存储控制器」的慰问信；之后可以在制作页自行打造。[/*]
[/list][b]前置要求[/b]
[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+（只需房主安装，客机有 SMAPI 即可）[/*]
[/list][b]它为什么顺手[/b]
没有任何东西会强加给你：不会自己弹菜单、不会替你放方块，每一项自动化开关都能关掉。只想要一个大箱子，用终端就够；想做产线，再加接口
[b]反馈[/b]
发现 bug，或者想把某个语言润色得更地道？非常欢迎在评论区留言。德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、俄语、日语、韩语目前是社区草稿，修正会一并署名。
